datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2011 in Chad. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) were compiled into spatial datasets for January, April, July, and October 2011, with multiple scenarios documented to support food security risk assessment.
